memories.content: Prefers Python. Uses Python for ML, scripting, and API work.
Uses PyTorch and TensorFlow. Prefers PyTorch for research.
Works at an AI startup building LLM-powered products.
Prefers Qdrant for vector search. Uses Qdrant in production.
ML engineer focused on inference optimization and memory systems.
Uses AWS: EC2, S3, Lambda, EKS.
Uses VS Code with Vim keybindings and Copilot.
Uses pytest for Python testing. Runs tests in CI with GitHub Actions.
Prefers microservices for scalability. Uses gRPC for inter-service comms.
Uses OpenAI GPT-4o as primary LLM. Also experiments with Claude.
Uses Neo4j for graph memory and entity linking.
Uses Kubernetes on EKS. Manages clusters with Helm and ArgoCD.
Uses Terraform for infrastructure provisioning on AWS and GCP.
Uses Prometheus and Grafana for monitoring. Alerts via PagerDuty.
Uses Kafka for event streaming. Topics partitioned by tenant.
Uses Redis for caching and hot-tier memory. TTL-based eviction.
Uses GitHub Actions for CI/CD. Builds, tests, and deploys on merge.
Prefers REST APIs with OpenAPI spec. Uses gorilla/mux in Go.
Uses Elasticsearch for full-text search. BM25 ranking enabled.
Uses Go 1.21+ for backend services. Prefers standard library where possible.
